items.note: S2.1 gives the outcome (X,Y)->(-Y,X) with every scratch wire restored for arbitrary initial scratch values, but calls the stages 'three forward stages' whereas the paper uses forward, inverse, forward (731-733, 760-762); the eight-row schedule and the net coefficient (JV+RG)x are absent.

S2.2 states the invariant, that the common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and that only edge changes D_vD_u^{-1} cost; this matches 804-821. It has no sub-steps, so it counts as stated, not derived.

Triple pairings, nondegenerate lines, orthogonal neighbours, nested labels and 'only central-wire edges decrease' are all correct, but the step 3->4 timing, the loss h, L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are missing.

S2.5 has endpoint matrices differing by I_m, s=Wm-N+2L<Wm, and the shear H<-H+D, as in Proposition prop:bit-motif-interface. The projection assignment and the rank-equals-dimension argument are not given.

S4.1 says frame differences are products of translation kernels aI+bX_v and that every role gets the C tensor power. It omits one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, and the diagonal corrections.
s<Wm and a deficit N-2L>0 are stated, but L<N/2 (L/N values), the deficits eta_b, eta_c and the explicit tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} via log m<20 are absent.
Both linear-time toolkits are stated in substance: split, merge and digit permutations; controlled offset updates and fixed-unit scaling mod q^b.

Both the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and the shear costing exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V) are stated correctly. The one-interchange three-update trick and the triangular O(V) updates are not shown, so it is not credited as derived.

The paper's route is followed: run the bit network on row streams, pay each edge by rank-many smaller interchanges, and use the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) on volume V/W, giving O(Ve^tau). Missing are the cyclic row split into W streams, the conversion of the shear into an interchange (D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D) and the fixed-tape schedule.
S3.4 states the O(Vu^tau) interchange of arbitrary u-bit chunks obtained by padding and splitting off high digits, in agreement with Lemma lem:chunk-swap.
H_0=bSCS and exactly s child calls on e/m axes per node are stated. The binary change of basis P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots and the inverse-kernel identity are missing.

S4.2 describes the mechanism correctly: whole-chunk cyclic shifts, then repair of a bounded exceptional set. The number of shifts (eight), delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}} and the cost bound are not given.

S4.3 gives s children per node, each on 1/W of the volume, an O(V((eK)^tau+1)) overhead and the outcome O(Vd^{lambda'}). It omits the recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+..., the leaf cutoff e<d^beta, the row field and the base-m pieces.

Output Q_p(Hz), error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, O(Vd^{lambda'}) and exact evaluation with O(d^{C_1}) guard bits all match. The subtree follows the paper's route, but the P_M basis change linking S4.1 to S4.2 and the row/slot setup are missing.

Signed-shift roots, DIF H_0 rounds, bit-reversed slots, the common-offset layout and the cost are correct. Missing are character cancellation F^+F^-=t^{-1}I, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}.
S6.1 states evaluation at 2^{4p}, four integer products by the established multiplier and centered read-back, as in Lemma lem:signed-ring-product. The O(rp log(rp)) cost is not given.

Two forward transforms in the retained LB order, pointwise products and the opposite transform, justified because a common permutation commutes with pointwise products, then a scale by M with error below sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}. This is the paper's route, but the error accounting is asserted rather than shown, so the verdict is conservatively partial.

P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions, the cost, and the tensor form with errors below dp^2 are correct. The condition theta>p/alpha^4 is reduced to 'large enough', the per-line error p^2 is omitted, and so is the axis-exposure cost.
S7.4 gives the F^+R=R^{-1}F^+ mechanism and (u*v)/S^2 correctly. S7.3 describes the Bluestein form without the chirp a_j=exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2/t_i) or the formula for QF_t.

The sizes b, p, d, T, r, t_i, the prime window and T/2<S<T are correct. Missing are eta=1/(4d), alpha^4 theta_i>p and the fixed rational exponents (tau, lambda, c, lambda', epsilon, delta); only kappa appears.
Phi as an isomorphism preserving cyclic convolution, realized by triangular controlled shifts, is correct. mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the triangular formula and the cost are missing.
Multiplying coefficient k by zeta^k with zeta=e^{pi i/r} is an isomorphism C[x]/(x^r-1)->C[y]/(y^r+1) that turns negative wrap into cyclic wrap, as at 4303-4318.

The source transform (A, chirp via twisted convolution, B_0, 2^gamma; counterpart RF_s) and the step sequence follow the paper. Missing are the digit prescale 2^{-b-2} and the conjugation definition of F^+, and the final scales are given as 'S and 2^{2b+4}' whereas the paper uses S and then 2^{2b+4}S (4517-4523).

The final bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma}<=448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, the rounding and the carries below 2^{2b} match. The error chain (E_ring, chirp, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, E_w) that yields the final bound is not shown.

All seven normalized terms, min g_i=2^{-181}=2 kappa, absorption of log powers and the final O(n(log n)^{1-kappa}) match the paper's route. The margins g_i are not computed, and the step does not say which term attains the minimum (g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)).
S0 only cites the n log n conjecture in its relies-on list and motivation. Nothing states the liminf criterion or that the bound refutes the eventual lower bound.

errors.paper: The stages are a forward invocation X->Y, then the inverse schedule from Y to X (effecting X<-X-Y), then a forward invocation; three forward stages would not give the exchange.

errors.says: method: express the tensor power through the complex phase network and bit-network recursion on e=mf axes
errors.paper: The layer recursion is driven by the complex network's phase frames (s_c children). The bit network enters only through chunk interchanges used inside the packed selected-bit additions.

errors.says: normalized convolution with error about 3 l M 2^{-p}
errors.paper: The error bound is sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}.
Step 4 multiplies by S; step 5 multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S, so the second scale includes another factor S.

errors.says: accumulated error of all transforms, scales S and 2^{2b+4}
errors.paper: The final error bound uses the scale 2^{2b+4}S applied to E_w=S(3E_s+2).

chain: The tree follows the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, labels, bit interface with s<Wm, matrix shear by rank-many interchanges, then the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). From there it goes to the layer, the transforms, retained permutations, assembly and the margin table. It thins out at the core of the saving: the label budget Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, rank = dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, L/N<1/2 and the explicit tau=1-2^{-50} are asserted or omitted rather than reconstructed. Downstream, the P_M basis change in the layer recursion and the error chain in exact recovery are also missing.

steps.note: The exchange (X,Y)->(-Y,X) and restored scratch are present and h=100 appears in S2.3, but indexing by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent, and the stages are miscalled 'three forward'.
S2.2 has the common frame commuting with pointwise gates, the operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the point that edges cost only the frame change.

Nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space with only central-wire edges decreasing are stated, but the time 3->4 and the loss h per edge are missing, as is the tensor space F^{otimes 3}. Rated conservatively.
S2.4 alludes to edge residuals, but nowhere does the plan say that P_V-P_U has rank dim V - dim U, or that the N source edges are rank-one exceptions.
s=Wm-N+2L appears, but the label budget sum|Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L and L=Ich, from which it follows, do not.
The deficit N-2L>0 is quoted, but the ratios L/N=100/539, 101/539 that make L<N/2 are not given.
Endpoint matrices differing by I_m on every role, giving the shear H<-H+D, are stated in their role in the chain.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly rank(A) interchanges plus O(V), and s calls per node are all present.
The recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) on volume V/W with result O(e^tau) is stated, but tau=1-2^{-50}, the bound eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 are absent. Rated conservatively.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the frame principle (C2), the endpoint identity (C7) and the rank-to-recursive-call link (C8), and states the recurrence without the explicit exponent. The arithmetic core of the saving is only named: rank equals dimension change, the label budget Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and L/N<1/2. So s<Wm is asserted rather than reconstructed.
